gold_note: Sauropod cladogram. Eight clade names are kept as internal labels: Sauropoda, Macronaria, Neosauropoda, Rebbachisauridae, Diplodocoidea, Diplodocidae (leader line) and Flagellicaudata, each printed beside a node dot, and Dicraeosauridae (a shaded box spanning one clade). Polytomies: the brachiosaur-titanosaur node (Tendaguria and two pairs), four rebbachisaurid stems, Rebbachisaurus-Rayososaurus-limaysaurines, and Pilmatueia-Amargatitanis-the rest. 37 tips, 4 polytomies (3, 4, 3, 3 children); 8 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 4 case (census 2, seed 20261201). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
